configure_cache_collection: configure the MongoDB cache collection name for cached responses in the HuggingFace datasets server
set_queue_ttl_seconds: set the queue TTL seconds value for job expiration in the HuggingFace datasets server
lookup_error_retry_policy: lookup the max failed runs per error code dictionary for retry policy configuration
get_prometheus_histogram_buckets: get the long duration Prometheus histogram buckets tuple for latency metrics
reference_viewer_kind_constants: reference the config and split viewer kind constants for cache entry type identification
